text: dsh-favorites-digest 是 DSH Web 插件，通过 /favorites 使用已登录的 Playwright 浏览器采集抖音和小红书收藏，并导出 Markdown 与 JSON。它可按主题分组、从已有 JSON 重建摘要，也可选生成 AI 综述、识别收藏中的 GitHub 项目或导出抖音喜欢。适合整理个人社交收藏。AI 综述需配置 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek 密钥；项目识别会查询 GitHub。
dsh-favorites-digest exports logged-in Douyin and Xiaohongshu saves as Markdown/JSON. Use /favorites to group items, rebuild a digest, optionally create an AI summary or identify GitHub projects.
想把抖音和小红书收藏整理成 Markdown 文件。
有没有办法把自己的小红书收藏导出成 JSON 和笔记？
我想按主题归类抖音收藏，还能选要抓取的平台。
怎样从之前导出的收藏 JSON 重新生成摘要？
Export my saved Douyin and Xiaohongshu posts into Markdown.
I want to organize my social media favorites by topic and rebuild a digest from JSON.
dsh-favorites-digest 的功能「双平台收藏导出」：通过 /favorites 登录并采集抖音、小红书收藏，输出 Markdown 和 JSON；可指定单个平台、条数或额外导出抖音喜欢。
dsh-favorites-digest 的功能「主题整理与摘要」：将收藏按标题、作者、标签和描述中的关键词分组，生成 Markdown 清单；配置可选模型密钥时可附加 AI 综述。
dsh-favorites-digest 的功能「收藏中的开源项目识别」：从收藏标题和简介提取 GitHub 链接或项目名，查询 GitHub 搜索接口核对后，将仓库及提及来源写入导出结果。
dsh-favorites-digest 使用前须知：AI 综述会把收藏标题、作者和平台发到所选模型接口，需配置 API key。见 src/summarize.ts:11-15、src/summarize.ts:24-50。
dsh-favorites-digest 使用前须知：项目识别会将收藏名称用于 GitHub 搜索，可关闭。见 src/projects.ts:120-125。

dsh-favorites-digest README · dsh-favorites-digest：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that exports **your own** Douyin and Xiaohongshu web favorites into Markdown (topic groups + optional LLM digest). It reuses a logged-in Playwright / Chrome session. Do not use it on anyone else's account.

dsh-favorites-digest README · Compliance — read first：- **Your own account, your own data.** Export only favorites from an account you logged into yourself (QR scan). Never point it at other people's accounts or data.
- **Respect the platforms.** Automated access may violate Douyin / Xiaohongshu terms of service even for your own data. Risk control may throttle or ban your account — that risk is yours; the tool works from your own logged-in session and solves no captchas for you.
- **No commercial use, no redistribution.** Exported content belongs to its original authors. Keep outputs for personal reference; do not resell, republish, or bulk-redistribute them.
- **Nothing leaves your machine.** Collection, artifacts, and digests all run and stay locally.

dsh-favorites-digest README · Install：Requires Node.js 20 or 22 and a Harness profile that mounts the `commands` and `sessionQuery` services (the official `web` / `agent` profiles do).

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-favorites-digest
npx playwright install chromium
```

Local checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-favorites-digest
```

Then in any session:

```text
/favorites login
/favorites
```
dsh-favorites-digest README · Install：Files land in `<session cwd>/dsh-favorites/favorites-<timestamp>.md` (and `.json`). The browser profile is stored at `~/.dsh/favorites-digest/profile`.

dsh-favorites-digest README · Commands：| Input | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `/favorites login` | Open Douyin + Xiaohongshu and wait until the web session is logged in |
| `/favorites` / `/favorites run` | Collect + write Markdown/JSON (LLM digest if an API key is set) |
| `/favorites collect` | Collect only (still writes the Markdown catalog, no LLM call) |
| `/favorites digest` | Rebuild Markdown from the latest JSON in the output dir |
| `/favorites --platform xiaohongshu` | One site |
| `/favorites --limit 50` | Cap per site (debug) |
| `/favorites --likes` | Also export Douyin 喜欢 |
| `/favorites --cdp-url http://127.0.0.1:9222` | Attach to an already-logged-in Chrome |
| `/favorites --no-llm` | Skip the digest section |
| `/favorites --out /path` | Output directory |
dsh-favorites-digest README · Commands：Same as other `ctx.commands` handlers: results stay off the model transcript (zero tokens).

dsh-favorites-digest README · Optional LLM digest：If `OPENAI_API_KEY` or `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` is set, `/favorites run` appends an AI 综述 section. Compatible OpenAI-style bases work via `OPENAI_BASE_URL` / `OPENAI_MODEL`. Topic grouping still works with no key.

dsh-favorites-digest README · Open-source project identification：`run`/`digest` also scan titles and descriptions for open-source projects — explicit `github.com/<owner>/<repo>` links plus dashed/camelCase names like `open-code-review` or `Windows-MCP` — and verify them against the GitHub search API, so the Markdown gains a 开源项目 section with repo, star count and which favorite mentioned it. Anonymous GitHub search is rate-limited (10 req/min), so at most 8 candidates are checked with spacing and the step degrades silently on 403. Set `identifyProjects: false` to turn it off; `digest` re-renders the stored list without re-querying.

dsh-favorites-digest README · How collection works：1. Open the logged-in 收藏 surfaces (Xiaohongshu profile → 收藏 → 笔记; Douyin `/user/self?showTab=favorite_collection`).
2. Listen to the page's own list JSON **and** scrape visible cards.
3. Scroll until the count stops growing.

Site redesigns can break selectors. Captchas must be solved in the opened window.

dsh-favorites-digest README · Troubleshooting：- **`collect` aborts with 未登录** — login detection uses hard signals (Douyin `sessionid` cookie; Xiaohongshu avatar-vs-`登录`-button probe). An abort means the session really is not logged in: re-run `/favorites login` and scan both QR codes; it only reports success after both platforms are confirmed.
- **Xiaohongshu shows “IP 存在风险” (error 300012) during login** — XHS risk control can block QR login from automated browsers on some networks. Log in inside a Chrome you launched yourself, then attach:
  ```sh
  "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" \
    --user-data-dir="$HOME/.dsh/favorites-digest/cdp" --remote-debugging-port=9222
  # then: /favorites --cdp-url http://127.0.0.1:9222
  ```
  Chrome ≥136 refuses `--remote-debugging-port` on the default profile, so the dedicated `--user-data-dir` is required.
- **CDP attach fails with “Browser context management is not supported”** — Chrome 154 removed the browser-level CDP calls older Playwright issued at attach time; requires `playwright` ≥ 1.64.
- **Why hard-fail when not logged in?** Logged-out collection used to silently export the recommendation feed as your “favo
